name: Surah Ta-Ha
summary:
Experience the recitation of Surah Ta-Ha, the twentieth chapter of the Holy Quran, in a deeply immersive virtual reality environment designed for Meta Quest.

This VR experience provides a calm and distraction-free setting where you can listen to and reflect on the verses of Surah Ta-Ha. The carefully designed virtual environment combined with high-quality audio helps create a peaceful atmosphere for concentration, reflection, and spiritual connection with the Quran.
